changes: Independent PE kernel; 56 input triples per call. Exact direct-product checker, exhaustive signed8 triples, extremal homogeneous groups, and deterministic random wider data.
conclusion: Use only numerically exact and measured primitives in full-network integration.

estimates.basis: 56 terms plus <=8 pipeline cycles; array interfaces need no internal frame memory. DSP estimates count one 27x18 multiplier per packed pair, two for direct control; LUT budget includes repair, control and possible fabric accumulation. Frame projection assumes1004 such PEs and excludes buffering/DDR.

interpretation: Compare measured DSP/operator LUT, achieved II and pipeline depth with the paper estimate. Inspect pre-adder mapping separately; a DSP count alone is insufficient.
name: exact10_residual_pair
notes: PE only; kernel latency is excluded from network rankings
purpose: Preserve generic signed10 coefficients as signed-low8 plus256*residual[-2,2]. Pack low coefficients, unpack each signed10-input product, and restore residuals using shifts/adds. This keeps the passing w10a10 precision despite failing uniform INT8 quality.
